summary.text: Mark Johnson is a Republican member of the Minnesota State Senate for District 1 who has served since 2017 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
He faces Democrat Bjorn Solberg in the general election.

paragraphs.text: Mark Johnson defeated Reed Perkins in the 2020 general election for Minnesota State Senate District 1.
In 2022 he defeated Dave Hughes in the August Republican primary and won the November general election.
